title: Tollway policy
description: A Tollway policy document. Amounts are integer strings in the asset's smallest unit.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor validates this file against. Ignored.

policyVersion.description: The policy format version. Unversioned documents are version 0.

mode.description: enforce (the default) blocks a payment when a rule fails. dry-run allows it and marks the would-be block in the trace.

dailyCap.description: Ceiling per UTC day, reset at the same instant as budgets.daily.

windowSeconds.description: Length of the sliding window, in whole seconds (at least 1).

cap.description: Most spend allowed inside any one window.

window.description: Sliding-window ceiling, for example 5 USDC per hour. May over-count by one accumulator bucket, never under-count.

perService.description: Caps per counterparty service, keyed by payee address or service id.

dailyCap.description: Ceiling per UTC day, reset at the same instant as budgets.daily.

windowSeconds.description: Length of the sliding window, in whole seconds (at least 1).

cap.description: Most spend allowed inside any one window.

window.description: Sliding-window ceiling, for example 5 USDC per hour. May over-count by one accumulator bucket, never under-count.

match.description: exact (the default) matches the resource string, query string included. prefix matches every resource starting with the key, character by character.

perResource.description: Caps per resource. Every matching entry applies and is charged, so a narrower entry can tighten a broader one but never lift it.

enabled.description: Allows or refuses this settlement model.

minChannelDeposit.description: Smallest channel deposit allowed. Channel mode only.

requestsPerMinute.description: Most counted events in any sliding minute. Shorthand for one 60 second window; do not combine with windows.

windowSeconds.description: Length of the sliding window, in whole seconds (at least 1).

limit.description: Most counted events allowed inside any one window.

windows.description: One or more sliding windows, all applied together, for example 60 per minute and 1000 per hour.

count.description: settlements (the default) counts settled payments. attempts counts every payment the client sends, including failed ones.

scope.description: global (the default) shares one count across every payee. per-counterparty keeps a count per payee address.

perCounterpartyKeyLimit.description: Most payees tracked at once under per-counterparty scope (default 1024). When all are active, a new payee is refused until one goes idle.

rateLimit.description: Agent-side rate limit: what is counted, over which sliding windows, and per which scope.

maxSpendPerMinute.description: Trips the anomaly stop when spend in any minute exceeds this.

smoothing.description: Weight of the newest minute in the baseline, a rational no greater than one.

sensitivity.description: How many deviations above the baseline a minute's spend may reach.

warmupPeriods.description: Completed minute buckets before this rule can block.

scope.description: One baseline per asset (the default), or per asset and payee.

maxBaselineGrowthPerMinute.description: Largest increase allowed when a completed bucket trains the baseline.

adaptive.description: An explainable EWMA detector over committed per-minute spend.
